extDescription.message: Minimal new tab page with bookmarks

permissionRequest.message: To cache bookmark icons, GNTP needs access to the bookmarked sites.

onboardEdit.message: Click ✎︎ to turn on edit mode.

onboardSettings.message:
Drag the ⠿ handle to move a bookmark or folder.
Click 👁︎ to hide a bookmark or folder.
Click ⚙︎ to open the settings.

onboardRoot.message:
Root folder — which bookmark folder this page shows.
Columns, font and language are here too.
Click ⚙︎ again to close the settings.
